summary.title: The Computer Science Book (Second Edition)
summary.one_liner: A practical map of core computer science for working developers, previewed chapter by chapter from theory of computation through large language models.
takeaways: Get an overview of core CS topics a working developer should understand, without a full degree.
See how the book covers theory, algorithms, architecture, operating systems, networking, and concurrency.
Find distributed systems, databases, and compiler topics such as CAP theorem, B-trees, and ASTs.
The second edition adds three V2 chapters: machine learning, deep learning, and large language models and AI.
summary.summary: This is the online landing page for The Computer Science Book, Second Edition, which offers chapter previews rather than full text. The page lists 13 chapters, covering theory of computation, algorithms and data structures, computer architecture, operating systems, networking, concurrent programming, distributed systems, programming languages, databases, compilers, and the three new V2 chapters on machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs. Each chapter has a one-line description of its subject matter and a preview link. The page is a table of contents and does not include the full text, code, or exercises.
